item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 05/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft covering southeastern China will bring generally fine and persistently very hot weather to the region for the rest of this week and early next week. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will be isolated showers over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 06/07 (Thursday)
Wind: Southwest force 4.
Weather: Mainly fine. Isolated showers in the morning. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 29 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
